description:
Outcome: A gardener sees their allocated plot and season dates, from brief.md §First version must, item 3.
Scope: Own application pending/waitlisted/allocated views, plot label and season dates, phone-readable statuses.
Excludes: Other household records, other gardener contacts and public plot-holder directory.
Acceptance: Displayed status, plot and dates match persisted records after reload; direct unauthorized requests fail.
Behaviour: Plain-language empty/loading/error/retry states and no allocation message; labelled, keyboard-operable phone UI.
Verification: Household isolation tests and mobile end-to-end status/date journey.
Prerequisites: T-003, T-005, T-006, T-007.
Assumptions: Only own household allocation is visible to a gardener.
title: Show gardener allocation and season dates
